## Prerequisites

You must have PaleoPAL installed with properly indexed libraries. If you haven't done so yet, please follow the [installation instructions](docker.qmd) before proceeding.

## Accessing the web interface

Navigate to the PaleoPAL folder on your computer. Make sure Docker is installed and running, then execute the following command in your terminal:

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

To access the PaleoPAL web interface, open your web browser and navigate to the URL where PaleoPAL is hosted. The URL should be `http://localhost:3000`.

## PaleoPAL web interface overview

The PaleoPAL web interface provides a user-friendly way to interact with the PaleoPAL database and perform various analyses. The interface is organized into several sections, each serving a specific purpose in the analysis workflow.

**Under construction:** This website is being updated to reflect the latest features and improvements in PaleoPAL. Please check back later for more detailed instructions and screenshots of the web interface.
